(`source=latest`), verbatim from `napix_responses`. Also needs `cases.view_all` (403 `forbidden`): a search answer
names cases the caller might not otherwise see. Each opening is audited `napix.response_viewed` (never the

server picks it). Refused with no call and nothing written: 404 `not_found`; 409 `napix_off`, `no_sample` (no body
and nothing held), `sample_hidden` (no body and the held sample belongs to a case you cannot see), `test_running`, `user_test_running` (your other test is still running: one test at a time per
person); 429 `test_too_soon`, `test_limit`, `napix_budget`. The court's own failure is a 200 with `ok: false`.
Nothing is applied to case data. ASLMS's own failure after the call answers 500: the call and its audit row are
recorded before the error.

post.description:
Search the court through NAPIX: by CNR (the dossier is fetched and stored), by case number or filing
number (every row stored, the asked row's dossier fetched; a held case with its dossier answers locally) or
by party name or advocate name (rows stored, dossiers on demand through `fetch-court`; an advocate search stores
the first `NAPIX_ADVOCATE_STORE_NOW` new cases now and the rest in the background, or none beyond them when the
court found more than `NAPIX_ADVOCATE_STORE_MAX`: `court_cases`, `queued`, `not_stored`). Refused when the switch is off (503 `napix_off`), the hourly quota is below the floor (503
`napix_budget`) or the caller used their hourly searches (429 `search_limit`). A CNR, case-number or filing
search that the ASLMS database answers returns `source: "local"`, `calls: 0` before any guard: never refused by
the switch, the floor or the hourly limit, and not counted (design `ownership-refinements`, decisions 4 to 6).
Audited.

(mandatory, an Indian 10-digit number).
